$comment: Laconia settings. Edit freely; the hooks re-read this every turn, no restart needed.
$mode: block = reject a violating reply and rewrite it before Marko sees it. advisory = log only. off = disabled.
$blockRules: Only mechanically unambiguous rules belong here. Judgment rules (length, bold-density, altitude) stay advisory and are handled by the output style.

circuitBreaker.$comment: After this many blocks in one session, Laconia downgrades itself to advisory for the rest of the session and says so once. Stops a bad rule turning into a loop of nagging.

browserFirst.$comment: Marko has asked for browser-based research six separate times (25 Jul, 3 Aug, 4 Aug x2, 20 Aug x2), so it gets denied rather than discouraged. WebFetch returns another model's summary of a stripped page and fails quietly. His stated reason for WebSearch on 20 Aug was new: sites reject the fetcher outright, so only a real browser loads a complete page. Search inside the browser instead. A duplicate deny also lives in ~/.claude/settings.json (installed by another agent) as a floor that survives disabling this plugin.

ledger.$comment: One JSONL line per turn-ending reply, at ~/.claude/laconia/ledger.jsonl. This is what /laconia reports on.
